headline: Strong H2 hinges on ATBS recovery

highlights: EBITDA margin guidance for FY27 was moderated to ~24% whereas the management expects normalisation (25%- 26% range) from FY28 onwards.

Apart from the legacy portfolio, VOPL ramp-up and commercialisation of newly announced capex (Rs5bn funded through internal accruals) will drive incremental growth over the medium term.  Stock correction of ~39% over last 1 year broadly prices in the recent underperformance and slower than expected scale up of the new portfolio.
Existing asset base (Rs28.6bn in FY26 incl CWIP) has the potential to clock peak revenue of Rs34bn.
Overall, we are building in Revenue/EBITDA/APAT CAGR of 22%/16%/13% over FY26-29E and also factoring in ROCE improvement of ~282bps over the same period.
valuation: Another capex of Rs5bn is under evaluation; further details will be disclosed in the coming quarters.
watch: ATBS recovery remains a key monitorable: ATBS formed ~28% of overall revenue in 1HFY27.

ATBS is the cash cow of VO with ~50% contribution at the Gross profit level. 50% capacity addition in ATBS (highest margin product where VO is the global leader) should be the key growth driver for next 2-3 years, in our view.
